\[
x=\frac{\pi}{4}\quad\text{and}\quad x=\frac{5\pi}{4}.
\]

\[
T=\frac{5\pi}{4}-\frac{\pi}{4}=\pi.
\]

Equivalently, the angular frequency is \(B=2\), so \(T=\frac{2\pi}{B}=\pi\).
